derivation:
by
  cases m with | zero => exact v.elim0 | succ n =>
    simpa [cycleNext, Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', Fin.ext_iff] using Fin.val_add_one v
explanation: Lean core gives the value of cyclic addition by one, branching on whether the vertex is last. After excluding the empty Fin 0 case and unfolding cycleNext, its condition simplifies to v.val + 1 = m.
